# Extract Video Without Audio

- Route: `/tools/extract-video-only-from-video`
- Kind: `tool`
- Category: `video`
- Slug: `extract-video-only-from-video`

## Summary

Export a silent / video-only copy with every audio track removed — perfect for silent previews, B-roll, edits, and re-scoring. (Video tools)

## Details

Sometimes you want the video without the audio — for a silent social-feed preview, a B-roll asset to drop into a new edit, or a re-scoring workflow where you will add fresh music. Media Manipulator strips every audio track and emits a clean video-only file. The video stream is stream-copied wherever possible, so there is no re-encode and no quality loss.
### What it does
- Removes every audio stream from your video.
- Stream-copies the video stream wherever possible — no re-encoding, no quality loss.
- Re-encodes to a compatible H.264 baseline only if the destination container requires it.
- Returns a silent MP4 (or WebM) you can drop straight into a new edit.
### How to use it
1. Upload your video: Drop any MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM, AVI, or M4V file.
2. Pick the output container: MP4 is the safe default. WebM is offered for VP9/AV1 sources.
3. We strip audio: FFmpeg drops the audio stream and copies the video stream when possible.
4. Download silent video: Save a clean, audio-free copy of your video.
### Supported formats
- Input: mp4, mov, webm, mkv, avi, m4v
- Output: mp4, webm
- Video stream is copied without re-encoding wherever the destination container supports it.
- Input videos that have no audio stream succeed normally and return a re-packaged copy.
### Technical details
- The default attempt uses `-c:v copy` so no re-encode happens — quality is preserved bit-for-bit on the video stream.
- If the destination container rejects the source codec, we fall back to a libx264 + yuv420p re-encode at CRF 20.
- No watermarks, no overlay, no scaling — the visual output is identical to the source by default.
### Use cases
- Silent social previews: Make a clean autoplay clip for Instagram, X, LinkedIn, or TikTok.
- Re-scoring projects: Strip the original audio before adding music or voiceover.
- Privacy-sensitive shares: Remove background conversation captured during a screen recording.
- B-roll prep: Drop an audio-free clip into a multi-camera or B-roll-driven edit.
### FAQ
Q: How do I remove audio from a video?
A: Upload your video and click "Remove audio from video". The tool emits a video-only copy in your chosen container.
Q: Will the video quality change?
A: No, in the default case. We stream-copy the video stream so the output is bit-for-bit identical on the video side. We only re-encode if the destination container needs it.
Q: Can I make an MP4 silent?
A: Yes — MP4 is the default output container and the most common use case.
Q: Is the original video modified?
A: No. The original upload stays untouched. We produce a new file and keep or delete the upload according to the retention rule: Files are kept 24 hours for guests; with a free account you choose 24 hours to 2 years.
Q: What if my video has no audio?
A: No problem — the tool succeeds normally and returns a clean re-packaged copy.
